name: Fuel Surcharge
description: Applied as a percentage of transportation charges, based on the weekly national diesel price index.
businessReason: Offsets fluctuating fuel costs based on US Energy Information Administration diesel index.

name: Delivery Area Surcharge
description: Charged for deliveries to ZIP codes classified as extended/remote delivery areas.
businessReason: Covers additional cost to reach remote or low-density delivery areas.

name: Residential Surcharge
description: Charged for deliveries to residential addresses.
businessReason: Residential deliveries require individual stops vs bulk commercial drops.

name: Additional Handling
description: Charged for packages exceeding size or weight thresholds requiring special handling.
trigger: Weight > 50 lbs OR longest side > 48 inches OR second-longest side > 30 inches
businessReason: Oversized or overweight packages require manual handling outside automated systems.

name: Demand Surcharge
description: Applied during peak shipping periods when network capacity is constrained.
trigger: Peak season (typically Nov-Jan) or volume surge periods
businessReason: Manages network capacity during high-demand periods.

name: Saturday Delivery
description: Charged for packages delivered on Saturday.
businessReason: Weekend delivery requires separate operational scheduling.

name: Declared Value
description: Insurance coverage for packages with declared value above $100.
businessReason: Additional liability coverage beyond standard $100 included.

name: Large Package Surcharge
description: Charged for packages exceeding 96 inches in length or 130 inches in combined length + girth.
businessReason: Large packages consume disproportionate trailer/vehicle space.

name: Premier Air Fee
description: Applied to premium air services with guaranteed early morning delivery.
businessReason: Guarantees priority loading and earliest delivery commitment.
